exercises.name: Optional Easy Elliptical Session
exercises.notes: Optional Saturday session. Reduce resistance first if the left knee is sore.

exercises.name: Standing Supported Low-Back Stretch
exercises.notes: Hold a stable rail, counter, or bench. Soften knees, send hips back, and keep the stretch gentle.

exercises.name: Elliptical Warm-Up
exercises.notes: Low effort warm-up. You should be able to talk comfortably. Keep resistance below your home cardio setting.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.notes: Tuck pelvis gently and squeeze rear glute. Avoid arching the low back.

exercises.name: Seated Row
exercises.notes: Pull toward torso with shoulders down and back. Record seat/chest-pad settings after first comfortable use. Starting load is set to 0 for import compatibility; replace with the first comfortable machine setting after your setup session.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press
exercises.notes:
8/8 - left shoulder seems better
Left shoulder pain 7/5/26, 7/15

exercises.name: Standing Chest Opener (Hands Behind Head)
exercises.notes: Stand tall with fingertips lightly behind your head and elbows wide. Gently draw shoulder blades together and lift the chest without arching your lower back. Keep the motion pain-free.

exercises.name: Ankle Rocks
exercises.notes: Dynamic mobility: complete about 10 controlled ankle rocks per side during the 30-second interval.

exercises.name: Standing Shoulder/Lat Stretch
exercises.notes: Keep ribs down and avoid pulling hard on the arm.

exercises.name: Shoulder Circles
exercises.notes: Dynamic mobility: complete 10 forward and 10 backward shoulder circles during the interval.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction
exercises.notes: Keep back against pad. Press outward with control; pause briefly and return slowly. Starting load is set to 0 for import compatibility; replace with the first comfortable machine setting after your setup session.

exercises.name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
exercises.notes: Hinge gently from hips with a long back; do not force the range.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Circles
exercises.notes: Dynamic mobility: complete about 8 controlled hip circles in each direction per side.

exercises.name: Standing Torso Turns
exercises.notes: Dynamic mobility: complete about 8 gentle torso turns per side during the interval.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Stretch
exercises.notes: Keep heel down and knee comfortably straight or softly bent.

exercises.name: Home Elliptical Steady Session
exercises.notes: Steady sustainable session at medium resistance. You should be able to speak in short sentences.

exercises.name: Pull Down
exercises.notes: Set thigh pad snugly. Pull toward upper chest, not behind neck. Starting load is set to 0 for import compatibility; replace with the first comfortable machine setting after your setup session.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.notes: Use rear-delt position only. Keep load light and avoid shrugging. Starting load is set to 0 for import compatibility; replace with the first comfortable machine setting after your setup session.

exercises.name: Sit-to-Stands
exercises.notes: Bodyweight warm-up. Rise from a stable bench or chair with controlled form.
